prompt.zh-TW: 上個月賒銷給學校的貨款，綠茵運動用品這個月先收到了 {{money:e1.amount}}。請寫出收款的分錄。
prompt.en: This month Greenfield Sports collects {{money:e1.amount}} of last month’s credit sale to the school. Write the entry for the collection.

explanation.zh-TW: 收到現金，借記現金 {{money:e1.amount}}；學校欠的錢少了，貸記應收帳款 {{money:e1.amount}}。營業收入在賒銷那一天就已經認列，收款時不再記一次，否則同一筆生意會算兩次收入。
explanation.en: Cash comes in, so debit cash {{money:e1.amount}}; the school owes less, so credit trade receivables {{money:e1.amount}}. Revenue was recognised on the day of the credit sale and is not recorded again on collection; otherwise the same sale would be counted twice.
